content: What rights do users have under this privacy policy?

According to Section 9 of the Privacy Policy Template, under GDPR users have the right to: access their personal data through a Subject Access Request, rectify inaccurate data, request erasure (the 'right to be forgotten'), restrict processing, object to processing, data portability, and to not be subject to solely automated decision-making. Users can exercise these rights by contacting the Data Protection Officer at the email address provided. Users also have the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority, such as the ICO in the UK.
